title: ElitePLM: An Empirical Study on General Language Ability Evaluation of Pretrained Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates pretrained language models on four cognitive-inspired dimensions: memory, comprehension, reasoning, and composition. The evaluation tasks and benchmarks used (e.g., GLUE, SQuAD, LAMA) are standard NLP tasks that test for general language understanding and generation capabilities, not for knowledge or reasoning related to faith, ethics, or morals.
